BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 810,000 ordinary shares for cancellation, with transactions occurring between June 29, 2026, and July 3, 2026. The highest price paid per share was 68.90 pence, and the lowest was 66.00 pence, with a volume-weighted average price of 67.9988 pence on July 3, 2026. Following these purchases, the company's issued ordinary share capital stands at 346,026,043 shares, with 3,867,640 shares held in treasury. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 06 July 2026 06 July 2026 'Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 29 June 2026 30 June 2026 01 July 2026 02 July 2026 03 July 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 141,522 146,572 316,164 0 206,718 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 67.80 68.20 68.20 0.00 68.90 Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 66.40 67.10 66.00 0.00 67.00 Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 67.0161 67.7057 66.9843 0.0000 67.9988 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 346,026,043 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 3,867,640 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 342,158,403 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. This disclosure is made pursuant to paragraph 9.6.6(R) of the Listing Rules. The table below contains detailed information about the purchases made as part of the Share repurchase programme.
